children: ), a world leader in innovative casual footwear for all, today announced that it will present at Piper Sandler's 2026 Growth Frontiers Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 11:30 AM ET.
A live broadcast of the Company's presentation may be found on the Investor Relations section of the Crocs website,
. A replay of the webcast will remain available on the website following the completion of the conference.

Crocs, Inc. (Nasdaq: CROX), headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, is a world leader in innovative casual footwear for all, combining comfort and style with a value that consumers know and love. The Company's brands include Crocs and HEYDUDE, and its products are sold in more than 85 countries through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.
